# Metric Card Patterns

## Core card types

### Snapshot card

Use when the audience needs the latest or current-period value only.

### Snapshot plus delta card

Use when the audience needs both the current value and a comparison against prior period, target, or YoY.

### Trend companion card

Use when the main chart already shows the time series and the card provides a headline summary.

### Ratio card

Use only when the canonical numerator / denominator logic is verified.

## Card rules

- State the exact time window on the card or in the subtitle.
- For rates, prefer percentage-point delta language for comparisons.
- Do not place a metric card on top of an invalidly aggregated rate.
- Weekly cards default to weekday-aligned YoY; monthly and yearly cards default to calendar/date-aligned comparisons.
- Show unit, currency basis, and constant-rate basis when relevant.
- Use absolute delta and relative growth for additive measures; use point delta for rates.
